name: Brian Bradley
original_name: ブライアン・ブラッドリー
source: The man [url=/c19742]Kyle[/url] is trying to find, Bradley is Kyle’s former partner and friend. Three years ago he switched sides and gave confidential police information to a crime syndicate he was supposed to be investigating. Kyle shot him, but Bradley disappeared and hasn’t been seen since.
